task: FE-52 / FE-59 / FE-61 / T-030 — current-source Android-to-macOS screen-share publication

android_emulator.source_revision: current workspace HEAD; build number raised from source +42 to avoid downgrading installed +2039

macos_receiver.build_source: current workspace; existing process was not restarted

session_safety.note: Android auto-joined with its microphone enabled. The UI microphone control was muted before MediaProjection started. An attempted app-op override was ineffective; Android later reported RECORD_AUDIO allow. Microphone activity before the UI mute was not measured, so transmission during that brief pre-capture interval cannot be ruled out. No audio was recorded or inspected.

checks.name: Signed current-source APK update
checks.observation: Release APK installed in place over 1.0.25+2039 without uninstalling or clearing app data. The signing certificate matched the installed app; runtime version reported 1.0.28+2040.

checks.name: Paired muted voice connection
checks.observation: Android and macOS both joined SHARE_TEST; both UI controls showed microphone muted. Android voice badge showed 8 ms and macOS showed 6 ms. These are voice connection RTT values, not screen receiver RTT.

checks.name: Android local full-display capture and preview
checks.observation: The Android system picker was explicitly changed from 'A single app' to 'Entire screen'. MediaProjection became active, the app showed its local full-screen preview and a 'Ваш экран' share card, and the filtered app log recorded local renderer first-swap and local thumbnail capture.

checks.name: Android sender statistics while Mac was connected
checks.observation: The Android sender diagnostic panel showed no sender data, 0 FPS and 0 kbit/s after the paired Mac client had joined. Filtered WebRTC logs reported 335 captured frames and no congestion/encoder-blocked frame drops, but also showed the video send stream inactive. These observations do not prove that encoded frames reached the SFU.

checks.name: macOS remote publication discovery and playback
checks.observation: While Android showed an active local share and both clients were connected, the macOS client listed the Android participant but did not expose a screen-sharing indicator or 'Смотреть экран' action; no remote stream appeared in the room view. Receiver diagnostics could not be sampled because the Mac had no selectable remote publication.

checks.name: Stop and cleanup
checks.observation: Stopping from Android cleared MediaProjection (dumpsys returned null). Android and macOS left the voice room; the macOS prejoin roster eventually showed 'Пока никого нет'.

limitations: The exact point of failure (Android publication signaling, SFU publication, Mac track event/subscription, or server-side visibility) is not established; no server-side logs were available.
No receiver frame/bitrate/loss sample was available because macOS did not discover a remote screen publication.
This API 35 emulator result does not establish physical Pixel or Windows behavior.
The workspace had unrelated pre-existing edits in the backlog, pubspec.lock, QA-229 and QA-230; they were not included in this evidence change.
remaining: Instrument and reproduce the track-publication lifecycle on Android and macOS. Establish whether a remote TrackPublished event reaches Mac, capture one sender stats report with a live receiver, then verify Mac Watch-screen discovery, decoded FPS and stop/unpublish cleanup. Keep FE-52, FE-59 and FE-61 open.
